# Tender response -- KESKIJKAU-2026-0143

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla -- technical property maintenance framework agreement

Visakoivu Oy has extensive experience delivering technical property maintenance and installation projects for both public and private clients across Keski-Suomi, including a rakennusautomaatio renewal project for Petajalahti Oy valued at approximately EUR 450,000, demonstrating our capability at the scale required by this framework.

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA competence certificate.

3.3 Visakoivu's equity ratio comfortably exceeds the required 20% threshold.

3.4 Visakoivu's annual turnover comfortably exceeds the required EUR 3,000,000 threshold.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Corrective maintenance faults are responded to within 4 hours for critical issues and 24 hours for non-critical issues.

4.3 Subcontracted work is managed under an approval and supervision process, with Visakoivu retaining overall responsibility.

4.4 The property asset register and maintenance documentation are handed over to the City in digital format at contract end.

4.5 We propose SLA targets of 95% of critical faults resolved within the response window, reported monthly.

4.6 New or modified plant is commissioned against a written test protocol.

4.7 Condition-monitoring data is collected via our maintenance system and made available to the City.

4.9 Our staff observe the City's access-control and site-security procedures.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 Pricing is quoted in EUR.

5.2 Subcontractor costs are itemised for transparency.

5.3 A cost breakdown is provided in the required format.

5.4 We accept a contractual penalty for service levels not met.

## 6. Forms and attachments

6.1 CVs of key personnel are enclosed.

6.2 An extract from the Trade Register is enclosed.

## 7. Submission format

7.1 Maintenance pricing is quoted per property.

7.2 All prices are rounded to two decimal places.

7.3 The framework pricing reference currency is EUR.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.1 Proposed energy-efficiency measures include monitoring plant run-times and flagging inefficient operation for correction.

2.3 Quality control and testing follow our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system.

3.2 Visakoivu already provides round-the-clock standby cover on a number of our maintenance contracts and confirms this will apply here without difficulty.

## Liite B -- Lomakkeet ja kaupalliset ehdot

2.1 A description of our quality management system (NMSB 7310:2015) is enclosed.
